description: This file defines the 'NewsAppState' class, which manages the application's state related to news articles. It handles data fetching from API or mock data, error management, and user interactions like saving or deleting articles. The class extends ChangeNotifier to support reactive UI updates in Flutter.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: A state management class for news data, handling fetching, caching, error states, and user interactions within a Flutter app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app state by loading saved news and fetching categories from the API, with fallback to mock data on errors.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns the list of articles for a specified category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns the top headlines based on a predefined count.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns the list of general news articles excluding top headlines.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Fetches and updates news for a specific category, with error handling and optional fallback to mock data.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Internal method to fetch news data for a category from the repository.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Loads mock data into all categories as a fallback.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with the given headline is saved.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in local storage and updates the saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a saved article by its headline.

methods.name: undoSaveByHeadline
methods.description: Reverts a save operation by deleting the article with the given headline.
